seo.title: AI automation for SMEs in Hainaut and Brussels | AInspiration
seo.description: Based in Givry, we automate the repetitive tasks of SMEs in Hainaut, Brussels and Walloon Brabant: invoicing, reminders, customer service. Free audit in 24h, on site or remote.

hero.title: AI for SMEs in Hainaut and Brussels
hero.subtitle: A local company, not a ten-person agency in Paris. We come to you, we speak your language and your tools, and we start with the task that costs you the most time.
hero.ctaSub: Answer within 24h, on site or remote

why.title: Why a local partner makes a difference

items.title: On site when it matters
items.body: Training at your premises, scoping meeting at your actual workstation, troubleshooting without a ticket queue. Mons, Charleroi, La Louvière, Tournai, Brussels: under an hour's drive.

items.title: Your tools, not ours
items.body: Odoo, Teamleader, Exact Online, WinBooks, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365: the software Belgian SMEs already use. We plug AI into it, we don't ask you to switch.

items.title: French, Dutch, English
items.body: An assistant that answers Flemish customers in Dutch and Walloon customers in French, without hiring for each language. Useful as soon as you sell in Brussels.

items.title: Data in Europe, Belgian contracts
items.body: EU hosting, GDPR, DPA available, invoices from a Belgian SRL. No grey area with your accountant or with the data protection authority.

sectors.title: The trades we meet most often
sectors.subtitle: Examples of what happens once the first task is automated. The figures are typical targets, not promised results.

items.name: Hospitality
items.body: WhatsApp bookings confirmed automatically, reminder the day before, cash reconciliation every morning without re-entry.

items.name: Trades and construction
items.body: Quotes generated from a dictated measurement, invoices sent when the job ends, unpaid reminders without thinking about it.

items.name: Retail and e-commerce
items.body: Product sheets written in three languages, routine questions handled by an assistant, stock alerts before a shortage.

items.name: Professions and firms
items.body: Incoming mail sorted, files prepared, long documents summarised, appointments booked without a phone call.

items.name: Associations and freelancers
items.body: Newsletter and social posts prepared in an hour a month, members chased automatically, lighter bookkeeping.

proof.title: Built for companies from here
proof.subtitle: Our work is documented: what was built and what it changed.

aid.title: Funding the project
aid.body: The Walloon Region and the Brussels-Capital Region offer digitalisation and consulting grants for SMEs; the conditions change regularly and depend on your size and sector. We tell you which apply to your case during the audit and provide the documents the file requires.
aid.note: We are not grant consultants: we point you in the right direction, your accountant or regional desk confirms.

items.q: Do you really travel on site?
items.a: Yes, across Hainaut, Brussels and Walloon Brabant with no travel fee. Beyond (Namur, Liège, Flanders) we favour video calls and come for training sessions.

items.q: Do we have to change our software?
items.a: No. Most automations plug into your existing tools. If a tool has to change, we say so before starting, not after.

items.q: How long before a first result?
items.a: The free audit is delivered within 24h. A first workflow is usually running five working days after the scope is validated.

items.q: What if AI is not the right answer?
items.a: We tell you. Some requests are solved with a simple tool setting or a procedure, and that is not billed.

cta.title: We start with a coffee and your real invoices
cta.body: Twenty minutes are enough to know whether an automation is worth it for you. On site or by video, no commitment.
